Plot calibration outputs across prey values

Source: R/functions-plots.R
plot_calibration_outputs.Rd

Creates paired calibration plots showing adult proportional mass loss and chick productivity across the range of prey values evaluated during a seabORD calibration run.

Usage

plot_calibration_outputs(
  sbordout,
  calibration,
  masslower = 0.09,
  massupper = 0.11,
  prodlower = 0.45,
  produpper = 0.55
)

Arguments

sbordout

A seabORD calibration-output object containing output_a0$data and output_c0$data.

calibration

A data frame returned by calc_calibration_range(). It must contain Prey and overlap columns identifying prey values that satisfy both the adult and chick calibration criteria.

masslower

Numeric scalar giving the lower acceptable bound for proportional adult mass loss. Defaults to 0.09.

massupper

Numeric scalar giving the upper acceptable bound for proportional adult mass loss. Defaults to 0.11.

prodlower

Numeric scalar giving the lower acceptable bound for chick productivity, measured as chicks per nest. Defaults to 0.45.

produpper

Numeric scalar giving the upper acceptable bound for chick productivity, measured as chicks per nest. Defaults to 0.55.

Value

A gtable object produced by gridExtra::grid.arrange() containing two vertically arranged calibration plots:

  • proportional adult mass loss across prey values; and

  • chick productivity across prey values.

Details

Proportional adult mass loss is calculated as:

$$ \frac{BM_{\mathrm{adult},t0} - BM_{\mathrm{adult}}} {BM_{\mathrm{adult},t0}} $$

The light-blue region identifies the range of prey values for which calibration$overlap is TRUE. These prey values satisfy the adult mass-loss and chick-productivity criteria simultaneously.

Grey dashed horizontal lines show the lower and upper calibration bounds. Solid vertical lines show the minimum and maximum prey values in the overlapping calibration range.

See also

calc_calibration_range() for identifying prey values that satisfy the calibration criteria and get_example_output() for loading example calibration output.

Other plotting functions: plot_BirdFlightMap(), plot_DBS_map(), plot_DD_map(), plot_DD_map_with_ORDs(), plot_ORD_obstruction(), plot_ORDpoly(), plot_adult_body_mass(), plot_brddata(), plot_chick_survival(), plot_colony_location(), plot_flight_distance(), plot_fltdist_base(), plot_frgcompdata(), plot_seamask()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sbordout <- get_example_output("cal_dd")

calibration <- calc_calibration_range(
  sbordout = sbordout,
  masslower = 0.09,
  massupper = 0.11,
  prodlower = 0.45,
  produpper = 0.55
)

plot_calibration_outputs(
  sbordout = sbordout,
  calibration = calibration
)
} # }
